title: Kafka consumers
description: Consumer-group lag, measured from the broker by the collector's kafka_metrics receiver (infra/lgtm/otelcol-kafka-lag.yaml).

panels.title: Lag per group (messages behind)
panels.description: Produced but not yet committed by the group. Growing = consumers can't keep up (or are stuck).

panels.title: Group members
panels.description: A step here is a rebalance: every member stops consuming while partitions are reassigned.

panels.title: Lag per partition
panels.description: One line per partition. A partition that lags while others don't = a slow or dead owner, or a hot key.
